account.signInDesc: Sign in to unlock AI insights, the web dashboard, and cross-device sync. The daily aggregates you have already recorded are uploaded too.
account.privacyNote: Until you sign in, nothing leaves this device. After you sign in, your account stores each day's aggregate (domain names, durations, and categories), your settings, your category rules, and AI analyses. Full URLs, page titles, and your browsing history are never uploaded.
account.signInBusy: A Google sign-in window is already open. Finish or close it, then try again.
account.autoSyncNote: While you're signed in, EchoFocus saves today's aggregate (domain names, durations, and categories) to your account every hour, and finishes each day at 00:05. URLs, page titles, and your browsing history stay on this device.
account.backfillDone: Backed up {n} days of daily aggregates.
account.backfillPartial: Some days could not be uploaded yet. They will retry automatically.
account.backfillSynced: Your daily aggregates are synced to your account.

privacy.storageNote: Stored on this device. Nothing is uploaded until you sign in, and full URLs, page titles, and your browsing history are never uploaded.
privacy.exportDesc: Download your browsing records and aggregate stats
privacy.deleteDesc: Delete all tracking records, daily stats, and AI analyses on this device. Settings and your account are kept. To delete synced stats and AI analyses from your account, use Delete all cloud data in the Privacy tab of the dashboard's Settings.
privacy.deleteConfirm: Start fresh? This removes all tracking data and can't be undone.

about.appDesc: EchoFocus is a focus tracker and pomodoro timer. It times the sites you visit and scores your focus each day. Sign in and Gemini writes a short review of your day from your numbers.
about.privacyItem0: Signed out, everything stays on this device (chrome.storage.local)
about.privacyItem1: Signed in, your account stores daily aggregates (domain names, durations, categories), settings, category rules, and AI analyses
about.privacyItem2: Raw URLs and page titles never leave your device
about.privacyItem3: Synced data travels over HTTPS, and database rules let only your account access it
about.copyright: © 2026 EchoFocus · Powered by Google Gemini AI

dailySummary.title: Today's focus score: {score}
dailySummary.messageWithStreak: {time} of productive time today, {n} days in a row.

onboarding.step0Title: Know where your day actually goes
onboarding.step0Desc: EchoFocus times the tab in front of you and turns it into a focus score. Sign in, and it also writes a short daily read on your patterns. No timer to start, no log to keep.
onboarding.step0Card0Desc: Starts the moment you open a tab and pauses when you step away.
onboarding.step0Card1Desc: Browsing data is written to local extension storage. After you sign in, each day's aggregate (domain names, durations, and categories) is also saved to your account.
onboarding.step0Card2Desc: A focus score and your top sites. Sign in for a short daily read in Today's review on the dashboard.
onboarding.step1Title: Tracking that needs nothing from you
onboarding.step1Desc: Browse the way you normally do. EchoFocus measures the active tab, pauses on idle or a locked screen, and sorts every site into one of three buckets.
onboarding.step1ScoreNote: Your score is focused minutes as a share of focused plus break minutes. Neutral time never counts against you. Any site can be recategorized in Settings.
onboarding.step2Title: Your browsing history never leaves this device
onboarding.step2Desc: This is the part most trackers get wrong, so here is exactly what happens to your data.
onboarding.step2Stay0Desc: Every visit, with its domain, duration, and category, is stored on this computer. Until you sign in, nothing is uploaded.
onboarding.step2Stay1Title: Sent for AI analysis after you sign in: a daily summary
onboarding.step2Stay1Desc: Aggregated numbers only: domain names, minutes per domain, and your category totals for the day. About twenty lines of text.
onboarding.step2Footnote: AI analysis needs an account and is optional. In the Privacy tab of Settings you can export your data as JSON or CSV, or delete the tracking data on this device. To delete synced stats and AI analyses from your account, use Delete all cloud data in the Privacy tab of the dashboard's Settings.
onboarding.step3Desc: Pin the EchoFocus icon to your toolbar and today's score is one click away. Everything below is optional.
onboarding.step3Unlock0Desc: Today, trends, and insights on any device
onboarding.step3Unlock1Desc: A short read on your patterns, kept day by day
onboarding.step3Unlock2Desc: Watch your focus score move across weeks
onboarding.step3Footnote: Signing in stores daily summaries (domain, time, category), settings, rules, and AI results in your account. Full URLs, page titles, and browsing history stay on this device.
onboarding.step3Incomplete: Sign-in didn't finish. If a Google sign-in window is still open, finish or close it, then try again.
onboarding.step3DoneTitle: Click the EchoFocus icon in your toolbar to start
